spans.s:
The affix ञ्य comes in the sense of 'this is his native-land' after the words शण्डिक etc.

Terms: ञ्य
The affix यत् comes optionally after the word शन, in the आर्हीय-senses

, when it is preceded by the word अध्यर्ध or a Numeral occasioning a द्विगु।

Terms:

The affixes ण्त् , यप् and ठञ् comes in the sense of 'age' after the word षण्मास।

Terms: ण्त् , यप् and ठञ्
